title: Budget Spent on Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation Packages
what_it_is: Budget Spent on Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation Packages

sections.label: PG and MG seniors benefited
sections.summary: About 450,000 PG seniors and 500,000 MG seniors have benefited since the packages began, with about 340,000 PG and 480,000 MG seniors as of 30 September 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: About 450,000 PG seniors and 500,000 MG seniors have benefited since the inception of the respective PG and MG packages.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As of 30 September 2022, there are about 340,000 PG seniors and 480,000 MG seniors.

sections.label: PG and MG Fund amounts
sections.summary: Eight billion dollars and $6.1 billion were set aside for the PG and MG Funds, with $3.04 billion and $0.72 billion disbursed as at 31 March 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Eight billion dollars and $6.1 billion were set aside at the inception of the PG Fund and MG Fund respectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: In recent years, we have enhanced the PG and MG benefits, such as the introduction of the Additional Participation Incentives for PG and MG seniors who join CareShield Life by 31 December 2023 and higher annual MediSave top-ups for PG seniors from 2021 onwards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As at 31 March 2022, $3.04 billion from the PG Fund and $0.72 billion from the MG Fund have been disbursed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As at 31 March 2022, there is a balance of $6.16 billion in the PG Fund and $5.72 billion in the MG Fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The Government will monitor the situation and, if necessary, we will top up these funds to honour the commitments to our PG and MG seniors.

sections.label: Silver Support eligibility
sections.summary: Silver Support is a structural scheme, so seniors younger than PG and MG can receive it when they reach the eligible age and meet the conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For Silver Support, instead of being cohort-based, as in we look at the PG and MG, Silver Support is actually a structural scheme that seniors who are younger than PG and MG, when they reach the eligible age, they also can receive Silver Support, if they meet the conditions.
